messages.content: Classify this patient comment: The bedside nurse noticed I was confused, stopped, and explained the schedule in a way I could follow.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The nurse recognized confusion and gave a clear, understandable explanation of the schedule.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I tried to ask the RN about the next step, but she kept finishing my sentences and brushed off the question.
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The RN interrupted the patient and dismissed a question about the care process.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: nurse was nice enough but i left that chat unsure what was happening
{"label":"communication_nurses","rationale":"The interaction was pleasant, but the nurse's explanation did not leave the patient informed.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: The attending invited me to summarize the plan in my own words and corrected one misunderstanding gently.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The attending checked the patient's understanding and respectfully clarified the treatment plan.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The consultant rushed through the imaging findings while standing in the doorway, then left mid-question.
{"label":"communication_doctors","rationale":"The consultant gave a rushed explanation and did not stay to answer the patient's question.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: After I asked for help sitting up, three call-light reminders passed before anyone responded.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"The patient made repeated requests and experienced a delayed response for mobility help.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I rang for nausea medicine and it arrived quickly, even though the hallway was hectic.
{"label":"staff_responsiveness","rationale":"The comment praises the prompt delivery of requested medicine.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Before the first dose, staff told me what the new liquid was meant to do but skipped possible unwanted effects.
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"Staff explained the new medicine's purpose but omitted information about side effects.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: unfamiliar patch appeared on my arm and idk who put it there or what it was for
{"label":"communication_medicines","rationale":"A medicine patch was applied during the stay without explaining what it was or its purpose.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The folder included a clear checklist of changes that meant call the office today versus seek urgent help.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"The checklist provided concrete warning signs and distinguished when to call from when to seek urgent care.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: I was taught the daily routine, but nobody said what worsening signs should bring me back.
{"label":"discharge_information","rationale":"The patient received routine instructions but lacked warning signs for returning to care.","confidence":"medium"}
Classify this patient comment: The plan looked fine on paper, except it required daily help from family who live several hours away.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The discharge plan depended on family support that was not realistically available.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: We sorted my take-home pills into a chart with the reason for each one, so I felt able to handle them.
{"label":"care_transition","rationale":"The medicine-purpose chart prepared the patient to manage take-home medicines.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The bedside table had dried residue underneath, and fingerprints stayed on the bathroom mirror all weekend.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"Dried residue and unclean bathroom surfaces are specific cleanliness concerns.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Fresh towels and a sanitized bathroom were waiting each morning.
{"label":"cleanliness","rationale":"Fresh towels and a consistently sanitized bathroom are positive cleanliness feedback.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: A nearby equipment alarm chirped every few minutes after midnight, making uninterrupted sleep impossible.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"Repeated equipment noise after midnight prevented the patient from sleeping.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Even near the nurses station, voices stayed soft overnight and I finally rested.
{"label":"quietness","rationale":"Low overnight voices created a quiet environment that allowed the patient to rest.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: The cafeteria cashier was helpful, but the dinner portions were much too small.
{"label":"other","rationale":"Cafeteria service and meal portions are outside the supported themes.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Finding the correct entrance from the garage took longer than the drive to the hospital.
{"label":"other","rationale":"Garage and entrance navigation are not covered by the supported feedback themes.","confidence":"high"}
Classify this patient comment: Fine overall, maybe a seven out of ten.
{"label":"other","rationale":"This is a nonspecific overall rating without a supported concrete experience.","confidence":"high"}
